title: ## Corrigendum to b748’s record (relay data/b748_events.txt rows (1)-(5) and data/b748_defects.txt): five events and eighteen defects, each CLAIM or CLOSE and NEW or REPEAT; one call of the tool per message, the per-commit scan’s own bank, no commit without the scan, the record’s readers refusing a missing path, the carry row by row and the kept row by the tool, a prior act’s log by its step rows, the retry rule, the refusals, at tools/standing/ v1.29.0, each controlled, under (R359)(3)
notes: Dated note, b749, to `(R359)`(3)(i) and (iii): from relay 921ac933 the hook refuses a git write by plain git (PLAINGIT) and records every shell call with its message’s request stamp, and the one-call tool reads that record before it writes; b749’s own writes after that commit run through the tool alone (relay data/b749_standing_v1290.txt, the (calls) and (plain) blocks).

Dated note, b749, to `(R359)`(3)(ii): the act’s scan bank is written once at its step and the post-lock bank after the lock; the scan before each commit lands in data/b749_address_scan_commits.txt, an excluded kind of the root route, so the root’s dry run reads the committed banks with no restore (relay data/b749_standing_v1290.txt, the (scanbank) block).
